verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents several in-product AI features that turn the user's own financial data into insights and suggestions. Users can ask plain-English questions about their business, AI Close uses agents to review transactions and surface discrepancies, Accounting AI runs prompts on top of the general ledger, and an in-app "ask AI" button suggests categorizations. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the plain-English Q&A insights feature (currently only marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger. The output reflects your existing accounts and categories.
